limits: Vendor documentation read once on 2026-11-22; some pages via an extraction service or search snippets (provenance secondary)
No tool installed, run or reproduced
Adopted means only that the owner chose the option for specification; binding only through the cited ADRs and specs

entries.title: Agent Skills open standard (AAIF)
entries.relationship: Portable SKILL.md folder format supported by Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and ThinkRail; name and description portable, allowed-tools experimental.
entries.decision: F1: harness exposed as a read-only Agent Skill over the CLI (owner 2026-11-22); binding only through ADR 0044 and SPEC-080.

entries.title: Claude Code plugin evals (claude plugin eval)
entries.relationship: First-party with/without ablation eval runner, 3 runs per arm, six grader types, JSON schemaVersion 1 for CI; scores advisory when hooks or real MCP servers run outside the sandbox.
entries.decision: Reference for F3/F6 design; candidate CI regression runner for the plugin itself; not adopted.

entries.title: Claude Code plugins reference and managed settings
entries.relationship: Plugin manifest components, version pinning, marketplaces; managed settings lock skills, hooks and MCP sources.
entries.decision: Context for F1 and F5 (pointer and governance model); no change adopted.

entries.title: Codex plugins, skills, sandbox and exec
entries.relationship: Codex accepts Claude-compatible plugin manifests and marketplaces, skills under .agents/skills, sandbox modes and exec --json events; no first-party harness eval.
entries.decision: Context for F1 portability tiers; no change adopted.

entries.title: OpenCode config, plugins, MCP and skills
entries.relationship: Plural list-shaped config keys (plugins, permissions, mcp.servers, skills); reads .claude/skills.
entries.decision: SPEC-080 task: verify the OpenCode install profile against the current schema.

entries.title: Pi coding agent (earendil-works/pi)
entries.relationship: Minimal harness (four tools, prompt under 1,000 tokens), Pi packages with extensions and skills installed by pi install, session trees, no permission layer by design.
entries.decision: Host target for SPEC-081 (owner 2026-11-22); integration not designed or tested.

entries.title: JetBrains ThinkRail
entries.relationship: Apache-2.0 incubator agentic IDE running Pi in-process; installs Pi packages, connects Pi mcp.json servers with approval, imports Claude/Codex skills, workspaces as git worktrees.
entries.decision: Host target for SPEC-081 through the Pi package; ACP relation unverified.

entries.title: Gentle AI (Gentleman Programming)
entries.relationship: Multi-host configurator writing native config for 17+ hosts (Engram memory MCP, ODD, receipt-driven review); a peer pattern that may rewrite host config next to Agent Braid.
entries.decision: Coexistence check in SPEC-081 and SPEC-080 install tasks; no integration.

entries.title: Harbor framework and Terminal-Bench 2.0
entries.relationship: Runs claude-code, codex, opencode and pi as black-box adapters in per-trial containers with per-phase network policy and -k attempts; TB 2.0 uses >=5 runs, oracle and exploit QA.
entries.decision: F2: hybrid substrate (owner 2026-11-22); binding only through ADR 0045 and SPEC-084; nothing installed.

entries.title: Terminal-Bench 2.0 paper
entries.relationship: 89 tasks, 32,155 trials, task QA with oracle, exploit agent and two auditors; canary self-assessed as largely symbolic.
entries.decision: F6 task QA method (owner 2026-11-22); results not reproduced.

entries.title: Inspect AI agent bridge and metrics
entries.relationship: Per-sample sandboxes, sandbox_agent_bridge proxying model calls, pass_at_k and pass_k_k reducers, clustered and bootstrap standard errors, append-only score edits.
entries.decision: Statistical and audit reference for F3; alternative substrate to Harbor, not chosen.

entries.title: Anthropic, Demystifying evals for AI agents
entries.relationship: 20-50 real-failure tasks, multiple trials, outcome grading, capability vs regression evals, pass@k vs pass^k, transcript reading.

entries.title: Anthropic, infrastructure noise in agentic coding evaluations
entries.relationship: Resource configuration moved Terminal-Bench scores by about 6 points; figures read from a secondary summary.
entries.decision: F6 infrastructure controls (owner 2026-11-22); primary page not read.

entries.title: Langfuse, LangSmith, Braintrust, Phoenix and promptfoo
entries.relationship: Immutable versions promoted by movable labels or environments, threshold CI gates, MCP servers and skills for in-host queries; no in-product paired significance tests.
entries.decision: F5 promotion pointers (owner 2026-11-22); no platform integration adopted.

entries.title: OpenTelemetry GenAI agent semantic conventions
entries.relationship: invoke_agent and execute_tool spans, gen_ai.agent.version; status Development.
entries.decision: F4 telemetry alignment (owner 2026-11-22); conventions may still change.

entries.title: OpenAI, Harness engineering and Unrolling the Codex agent loop
entries.relationship: AGENTS.md as a ~100-line map, repository docs as system of record, mechanical checks, observable app, garbage-collection agents; Codex harness defined as the agent loop.

entries.title: Mario Zechner, minimal coding agent
entries.relationship: Argues MCP servers cost 7-9 % of context, prefers skills plus CLI, no permission prompts.
entries.decision: Supports skill-first F1; no claim adopted.

entries.title: DSPy GEPA optimizer
entries.relationship: Selects candidates on the validation set, so a separate untouched test split is needed before adoption.
entries.decision: Held-out rule for any future automatic refinement; not adopted.
